subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The essayist’s sole intention was to __baffle__ his readers.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Puzzle**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Baffle**: To cause someone to be unable to understand or explain something. (चकरा देना)
 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of the given words.
 
 
• **Puzzle**: Cause someone to feel confused because they cannot understand something. (उलझन)
 
• **Influence**: The capacity to have an effect on the character, development, or behaviour of someone or something. (प्रभाव)
 
• **Scold**: Remonstrate with or rebuke someone angrily. (डांटना)
 
• ​**Annoy**: Make someone a little angry; irritate. (चिढ़ाना)
 
 
 
• ​According to the meaning of the given words "**Puzzle**" is the most appropriate synonym for "**Baffle**."
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.
